entries.test_name_or_assertion: runloop manual mode: ordering, periodic, cancel
entries.control: Production Runloop with SimClock; advance and pumpDue control timer order and cancellation.
entries.limitations: Core host tests; not HTTP queued-write deadline proof.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: mesh: membership, config, and events converge with loss and delay
entries.control: InMemNet setDelayMs(3), setDrop(0.20, 20250827), and SimClock; fixed seed makes loss reproducible.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: mesh: partitions elect local leaders and heal without event loss or duplication
entries.control: Partition/heal actual Mesh instances using InMemNet and SimClock.
entries.limitations: Host network simulation, not device packet-loss qualification.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: store: metadata batches roll back atomically on write failure
entries.control: SQLite trigger injects a real write failure; production Store transaction must roll back prior writes.
entries.limitations: SQLite host path; no copied business model.

entries.control: Actual Httpd listener, production Runloop routing and TCP requests; stop/start changes listener.
entries.limitations: Queued/entered mutation gates are still T04 work.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: clock: the time-service offset corrects every wall reading
entries.control: SimClock implements production IClock; setWallOffsetMs changes corrected reads without changing the host clock.
entries.limitations: Does not alone qualify every UI countdown.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: [R2] capi unregister drains an entered UI callback
entries.control: Condition-variable entry/release barrier around a real C callback; unregister joins before destroy.
entries.limitations: The 25 ms negative wait is bounded observation, not proof of Swift acquire/stop ordering. Q10 remains for T20.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: timeout intent wins over abort and status=0 ready-state notifications
entries.control: Load actual app.js; manually deliver fake-XHR timeout/abort/ready-state and fake timers.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: a stream resolving after stop is immediately released
entries.control: Deferred getUserMedia promise resolves after stop; existing assertion requires tracks to stop. Mutation sensitivity removes the real branch and observes AssertionError.

entries.test_name_or_assertion: Actual production module/page scripts loaded by existing Node runners
entries.control: VM DOM/network boundaries are injected; the production controller is loaded directly.
entries.limitations: Real browser smoke separately covers authentication and navigation, not media playback or bfcache certification.
